newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal closes higher on exports, cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal closes higher on exports, cash.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures closed higher on active exports and firm cash basis values, traders said.
Gains in soybean futures also supported prices as did soymeal/soyoil spreading, they said.
The meal/oil spreading pressured soyoil futures, they said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, down from 18,121 Friday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil volume was estimated at 10,000 contracts, down from 10,948 Friday, the CBOT said.
Soymeal closed $1.20 to $2.00 per ton higher, with December up $1.30 at $230.00. Soyoil was 0.15 cent per lb lower to 0.05 higher, with December down 0.14 at 23.13.
